boards.product: ESP32-S3 AIoT Basic V2 development board
boards.hardware: ESP32-S3 AIoT Basic V2 with an SPA06 pressure/temperature sensor and an SHT30 temperature/humidity sensor on I2C; ST7789 240x240 LCD
boards.identify: The AIoT Basic V2 learning board (about 145 x 135 mm) with the two sensors attached
boards.flash_port: USB-C. Download mode: hold BOOT while plugging in.
boards.use: Sensor monitor: pressure, temperature and humidity sent to the agent over BLE (device I/O example)
boards.notes: Check the sensor and display wiring against boards/tem-monitor/config.h.

zh.identify: AIoT Basic V2 学习板（约 145 x 135 mm），接了这两个传感器
zh.flash_port: USB-C。下载模式：按住 BOOT 再插 USB。
zh.use: 环境监测：气压、温度、湿度通过 BLE 发给智能体（设备 I/O 示例）
